description: a release smoke test of the hand-offs: brainstorm, capture, plan, implement and review in one conversation; it checks each stage received the one before it, not its quality
prompts: /f10:brainstorm A dashboard wants to show how many notes the notes server holds. Is an endpoint for that worth adding, and what shape should it take?
Agreed. Settle it as: GET /notes/count answers the number of .txt notes in the notes directory as plain text, such as 2, and 0 for an empty directory. One task.

accept.run: d=$(mktemp -d) && printf x > "$d/a.txt" && printf y > "$d/b.txt" && go build -o "$d/notes" . && { "$d/notes" -addr 127.0.0.1:18765 -dir "$d" & p=$!; sleep 1; curl -s --max-time 5 127.0.0.1:18765/notes/count; kill $p; }
